text:
For this activity you need two teddies and around 10 pennies.

Ask your child to give half of the pennies to each teddy. Ask them to count how many pennies each teddy has, then how many pennies there are overall.

Talk to your child about doubling and halving. For example, if there are four pennies overall, and each teddy has two pennies, then that means four is double two, and two is half of four.

Repeat the activity, changing the number of pennies there are overall each time.
